name: aes_isbox_strict_365cx
detail: BDD path sum reached the normal form for all inputs and outcomes (32 measurements, 96 H, 64 HH, 0 omega; 17961 BDD nodes)
reference_how: copied from the development project; checked against an independent definition (AES tables)
wires: q[0..7] = x (bit i = coefficient of x^i, AES field GF(2^8)/x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1), q[8..15] = y, q[16..25] ancillas
note: y ^= S^-1(x) for any y; 32 AND, 26 qubits.
